page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-standard-16-lssd is an arm64-based server instance featuring 16 dedicated virtual CPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a balanced resource allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core. The instance operates on a dedicated CPU allocation model, ensuring consistent processing capabilities without resource sharing. There are no graphics processing units included in this configuration, and local storage is specified as none. Additionally, the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Operating on the arm64 architecture, this server family is designed for modern cloud-native workloads that benefit from high-density, energy-efficient ARM processors. Qualitatively, the arm64 architecture offers a cost-efficient profile for multi-threaded applications, providing a balance of compute power and memory capacity. Without local storage or GPU acceleration, this instance is suited for workloads relying on network-attached storage. Appropriate workloads include general-purpose web serving, application servers, microservices, containerized deployments, and distributed systems that require a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio.
